overloadMerges.note: columnNumber is an out-parameter (the list box column where the drop occurred), not an input; the mechanical draft parsed it as direction 'in'.

params.name: columnNumber
params.description: Receives the list box column number where the drop occurred (-1 if beyond the last column)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Called while handling a drag-and-drop event over a list box: returns the row number where the item was dropped, and fills in columnNumber with the column.

discriminatedBy.rule: Not selected by parameter type (both overloads take one optional Integer out-parameter); the applicable overload depends on the destination form object's type (list box vs picture) at the time of the drop event, which is not statically knowable from the call site.

overloadMerges.note: pictPosY is an out-parameter (the Y coordinate of the drop in a picture object), not an input; the mechanical draft parsed it as direction 'in'.

params.name: pictPosY
params.description: Receives the vertical (Y) pixel coordinate of the drop, local to the picture object

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Called while handling a drag-and-drop event over a picture-type variable/field: returns the X pixel coordinate of the drop, and fills in pictPosY with the Y coordinate.

discriminatedBy.rule: Not selected by parameter type; the applicable overload depends on the destination form object's type (picture vs list box) at the time of the drop event, which is not statically knowable from the call site.

constraints: Over a hierarchical list, the function result is an item position; over a text/combo box/4D Write Pro area, it is a character position within the string; in these cases there is no out-parameter.
Returns -1 if the source was dropped beyond the last element/item of the destination, or if called outside a drag-and-drop event over a droppable object.
Only applies to a form object whose Droppable property is selected.
